analysis.headline: Shares Your Data for Ads
analysis.quote: We may share your e-mail or advertising identifier with our vendor having a network of users who used to play our games and ask the vendor to promote our games to users who might be interested.

analysis.headline: Shares Your Data with Partners
analysis.quote: These advertising partners may use this data (and similar data collected from other services) for purposes of delivering targeted advertisements to you when you visit third-party services within their networks.

analysis.headline: Shares Your Data with Vendors
analysis.quote: These vendors process your data only at and according to Supercell´s instructions to provide the Service, and perform tasks such as hosting, player support, advertising, analytics and fraud prevention.

analysis.headline: Tracks Your Activity Across Sites
analysis.quote: We and our partners collect and store information about users' interactions with unaffiliated websites and applications that use our technologies, including cookies and similar tracking technologies.

analysis.headline: Profiles Your Data
analysis.quote: In all of the above cases and purposes, we may analyze, profile and segment all collected data.

analysis.headline: Your Data Leaves Your Country
analysis.quote: Our Service is global by nature and your data can therefore be transferred outside of the jurisdiction in which you reside.

analysis.headline: Retains Your Data Indefinitely
analysis.quote: Note that if you ask us to remove your personal data, we will retain your data as necessary for our legitimate business interests, such as to comply with our legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements.

analysis.headline: Opt-outs Are Device-Specific
analysis.quote: Please note that opt-outs are specific to each browser and device and it may take a little bit of time before your opt-out will take effect.

analysis.headline: Collects Your Partner Data
analysis.quote: We also use third-party partners, such as social networking sites, data analytics providers and advertising networks to supplement information we have about you
